primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: ORR was defined as the percentage of participants who had a confirmed complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) per RECIST v1.1 by investigator determination. Responses are based on Investigator assessments per RECIST 1.1 without confirmation using all scans up to the cutoff date.
